description.short: Redacted practice and compliance activity alerts from 1Squared.
description.full: Delivers redacted task, approval, key date, enquiry, credit control, and compliance register activity notifications from the 1Squared platform into the Microsoft Teams Activity Feed without exposing confidential client or matter content.
